label_definition.generation_method: scenario threshold rules over simulated supplier attributes and performance rows
label_definition.independence_boundary: Labels do not call the tested weighted composite score, but they are not human or real-world labels.

frozen.top3_definition: hit when at least one acceptable supplier label appears in the first 3 returned suppliers
notes: Labels are generated by scenario threshold rules over simulated supplier outcomes.
Labels do not use the tested weighted composite scoring formula.
Top-3 hit rate is an any-acceptable-label metric, not exact best-supplier ranking.
